Chief Economic Advisor Highlights Economic Resilience and Private Sector Role

Chief Economic Advisor V. Anantha Nageswaran stated that the Indian economy is more likely to be resilient than vulnerable. He urged India Inc., the private sector, to increase investment, hiring, and offer fair compensation. Nageswaran emphasized the need for the private sector to step up its role in economic growth.
